articles.title: NASBA appoints Brant Beard as new CIO
articles.mainIdea: NASBA appoints Brant Beard as new CIO
articles.summary: The Accountant: NASBA appoints Brant Beard as new CIO. Beard, who succeeds Cheryl Farrar, joins NASBA after 21 years at HCA Healthcare.

articles.mainIdea: Molina Healthcare of Washington Announces $75,000 Grant to the Seattle Indian Health Board to Support Completion of Thunderbird Treatment Center
articles.summary: Business Wire: Molina Healthcare of Washington Announces $75,000 Grant to the Seattle Indian Health Board to Support Completion of Thunderbird Treatment Center. SEATTLE, January 06, 2026--Molina Healthcare of Washington announces $75,000 grant to the Seattle Indian Health Board to support completion of Thunderbird Treatment Center.
